Pathway enrichment for the 98 proteins significantly more abundant in DKO cerebral cortices with a FDR = 0

Pathway enrichment for the 98 proteins significantly more abundant in DKO cerebral cortices with a FDR = 0.03. Top: STRING functional protein association network. The FDR = 0.03 was used to reduce the number of proteins for better visualization. Bottom: terms highly enriched in KEGG‐pathways and GO cellular components. The same terms appeared at the top of the lists using a FDR of 0.03 (98 proteins) and 0.05 (191 proteins). The thickness of connecting lines indicates the strength of data support for an association
